item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single authoritative 2024 presidential document that cleanly bundles priorities, budgets, appointments, timelines, and enforcement into one unified Erdoğan program. Instead, the implementation trail is distributed across the annual program, the investment program, central-bank staffing, IMF/World Bank planning, procurement systems, and coercive enforcement cases.","evidence":[{"title":"2024 Yılı Cumhurbaşkanlığı Yıllık Programı 25/10/2023 Tarih ve 32350 (Mükerrer) Sayılı Resmi Gazete’de yayımlanmıştır","publisher":"T.C. Cumhurbaşkanlığı Strateji ve Bütçe Başkanlığı","date":"2023-10-25","url":"https://www.sbb.gov.tr/2024-yili-cumhurbaskanligi-yillik-programi-resmi-gazetede-yayimlanmistir/?device=1","summary":"The annual program says macroeconomic, fiscal, and sectoral policies were specified as one-year actions with quarterly monitoring, evaluation, and performance indicators. This is direct evidence of program-to-implementation translation through timelines and measurable tasks.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"2024 Yılı Yatırım Programı Yayımlandı","publisher":"T.C. Cumhurbaşkanlığı Strateji ve Bütçe Başkanlığı","date":"2024-01-15","url":"https://www.sbb.gov.tr/2024-yili-yatirim-programi-yayimlandi/","summary":"The investment program allocated 1,006.9 billion TL across 12,041 projects, including 510 billion TL for earthquake measures and large allocations to transport, education, health, energy, and industry. This is strong evidence of a concrete budgeted program with sector priorities and project counts.","question_ids":["8B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Press Release on the Appointment of CBRT Governor (2024-06)","publisher":"Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye","date":"2024-02-04","url":"https://www.tcmb.gov.tr/wps/wcm/connect/en/tcmb%2Ben/main%2Bmenu/announcements/press%2Breleases/2024/ano2024-06","summary":"Erdoğan appointed Fatih Karahan, a technocrat, as governor, and the bank explicitly framed the mandate around price stability and disinflation. This shows program implementation through appointment of a specific professional rather than a patronage pick.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"1.1.2 Monetary Policy Committee","publisher":"Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye","date":"2024","url":"https://www3.tcmb.gov.tr/yillikrapor/2024/en/m-1-1/","summary":"The MPC is a formal committee with named economists/academics, recorded meetings, and a price-stability mandate. That is a concrete institutional mechanism for carrying the macro program into repeated policy decisions.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Türkiye - Country Partnership Framework for the Period FY24-FY28","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-03-12","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099031824111097800","summary":"The CPF is aligned with Türkiye’s 12th National Development Plan and structures the agenda around growth, inclusion, resilience, and sector-specific engagement areas. It shows Erdoğan’s broader policy direction being converted into a multi-year institutional framework with named areas.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Türkiye","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/ext/tr/country/turkey","summary":"The World Bank’s Türkiye page says the CPF was refined into five engagement areas, including agriculture and water, energy transition, transport infrastructure, SME support, and resilience. This is concrete evidence of a program broken into operational policy lanes.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"2024 Yılında İlk 3 Ayda E-İhale ile Yapılan Tasfiyelik Satışlardan 913 Milyon TL Kamu Geliri Elde Edildi","publisher":"T.C. Ticaret Bakanlığı","date":"2024-04-16","url":"https://ticaret.gov.tr/haberler/2024-yilinda-ilk-3-ayda-e-ihale-ile-yapilan-tasfiyelik-satislardan-913-milyon-tl-kamu-geliri-elde-edildi","summary":"The ministry says e-auctions have been used since 2014 and are designed for transparency and accessibility, with online participation and competitive sales. This is a concrete enforcement/implementation mechanism for a rule-based public-market channel.","question_ids":["8B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Türkiye: 2024 Article IV Mission Press Release","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-08-28","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/08/28/pr24311-turkiye-2024-article-iv-mission-press-release","summary":"IMF describes a post-2023 policy turnaround, fiscal consolidation needs, tax-base broadening, VAT unification, SME simplification, and a one-stop shop for business approvals. This is strong external confirmation that the program was being translated into specific policy instruments.","question_ids":["8B.2","5B.6"]},{"title":"Republic of Türkiye: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for the Republic of Türkiye","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-10-11","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/10/11/republic-of-trkiye-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-556139","summary":"The IMF says tax and expenditure measures, AML/CFT updates, and a new anti-corruption strategy were being pursued. That indicates concrete reform apparatus rather than pure rhetorical positioning.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Türkiye: Stonewalling on Charges for Officials in Earthquake Deaths","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-03-27","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/27/turkiye-stonewalling-charges-officials-earthquake-deaths","summary":"Turkish law requires prior administrative permission to investigate public officials, and HRW says authorities refused to provide information and only a tiny number of permissions were granted. This is a direct negative example of weak enforcement and blocked accountability.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Türkiye government removes elected opposition mayors","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-11-07","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors","summary":"Removing mayors and replacing councils with appointees shows enforcement power being used to neutralize opposition-held local institutions rather than to implement a neutral program. This is strong evidence of selective institutional control.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","7B.10"]},{"title":"Turkey blocks access to Instagram platform but gives no reason","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/turkey-blocks-access-to-instagram-platform-but-gives-no-reason/2204688/","summary":"Turkey blocked Instagram nationwide without explanation or duration, and a later arrest followed criticism of the ban. This is concrete enforcement of information control, not transparent program execution.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Freedom in the World 2024: Turkey","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says officials were widely accused of publishing distorted data, state media favored the AKP, and key appointments after 2023 improved transparency only in some areas. This is mixed evidence: some policy translation improved credibility, but broader enforcement still leaned toward regime protection and message control.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]}]}
